status.comment:
Programme closed (last cut-off Oct 2023; listed as closed by BMFTR). Successor KMU-innovativ: IKT needs an existing company; earliest realistic cut-off 15 Apr 2027 if a company is founded first.

Research 2026-10-15: KI4KMU is closed. The BMFTR programme site lists it under 'Geschlossene Förderaufrufe' (entry dated 15.12.2025) and describes it in the past tense: eight cut-offs between May 2020 and October 2023, 100 projects selected (https://ki-und-softwaresysteme.de/foerderschwerpunkte/kmu-foerderung/ki4kmu/, https://ki-und-softwaresysteme.de/bekanntmachungen/). The '15 Oct 2026' deadline in meta/german-eu-grants-2026.md was wrong. Even when open it required an existing KMU (company) and favored Verbund projects with research institutions. Nearest open successor: KMU-innovativ: IKT (rolling; cut-offs 15 April / 15 October; next after today is 15.04.2027), which also requires an existing KMU with a German site — not possible before a company exists.
